events.title: Freddie Mercury remembered

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His incredible voice and stage presence continue to inspire.

angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A truly pivotal moment in music history.
